rows: Maintenance Procedures Information System (MPIS)
Generating Stations
Maintenance Procedures
Document No.: Turb-033-r0a
Equipment: Mechanical parts of the turbine
Status: Approved
Issued to: Esna Power Station
Document approval date: 26 November 2007
Procedure: Annual maintenance (I1 - Y1)
Next review date: November 2012

This document sets out the annual maintenance steps for the mechanical parts of the turbine. The first draft of the document was prepared and field-tested by Eng. Abd El-Salam Abd El-Hamid Metwally at Esna Power Station, reviewed by Eng. Youssef Mahmoud Ali, endorsed by Eng. Abd El-Karim Moussa Ahmed: Mechanical Maintenance Department Manager at the station, approved by Eng. Youssef Mahmoud Ali: General Manager of Esna Power Station, and certified by Eng. Mohamed Osama Suleiman Selim: General Manager of Technical Inspection at the Hydro Power Stations Company for Electricity Generation and MPIS Coordinator.
Issue an approved work permit; maintenance personnel must hold the occupational safety and health category card
Follow the occupational safety and health instructions and procedures, e.g. wearing a safety helmet and safety shoes, etc.
Make sure the work area is marked out and the appropriate warning signs are posted
Shut down the unit and put it in maintenance mode
Occupational safety and health and personal protective equipment (PPE)
Safety pin
Blade locking prevention device
Close the unit's inlet and outlet gates
Dewater and dry the unit
Open the runner inspection door
Open the guide vanes
Fit the Locking Device on the servomotor (blade locking prevention device)
Check the guide vane arms and replace the safety pin if necessary
Check and measure the clearances of the guide vanes and the runner
Check the joints between the fixed parts
Inspect the runner hub gasket
Inspect the runner blades and runner hub to make sure no cavitation has appeared
Inspect and check the maintenance rubber seal in the stuffing box
Inspect and check the operating rubber seal of the stuffing box
The overhaul and cleaning works on the mechanical speed governor are carried out as per the station's major equipment outage programmes
